Alex —

Great to hear — congrats on the internal go-ahead. I've attached a working Mutual Action Plan and our standard procurement checklist to this thread. Quick notes up front: 

- SKU mapping: we can provide a per-SKU cost estimate tied to the selected instance classes and expected token throughput. Karthik will own the billing mapping.
- SOW/MSA: we typically share a customer-facing SOW (see attached PDF) and route MSA redlines through our legal; timeline is ~7-10 business days for standard comments.
- Co-sell manifest: below I’ve pasted the ops lanes we typically use and proposed owners.

Proposed lanes (summary):
- Lead capture & routing: Helio owns lead qualification; Redwood tags partners in HubSpot and routes leads to GCP co-sell queue.
- Reporting & KPI: Weekly pipeline digest to Partner Ops + monthly exec summary.
- Procurement & billing: Helio procurement owns PO issuance; Redwood Billing sends SKUized invoice and usage export to your finance contact.

Can we schedule a 30-minute kickoff on Monday to confirm owners and timelines? I can send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole

Alex / Marissa —

Looping in the mapping doc for procurement lanes. A couple practical constraints from our finance side: 

1) Billing cadence: Redwood issues monthly invoices with SKU-level usage exports by the 5th of the following month. If Helio requires invoicing to GCP for marketplace billing aggregation, we can provide a usage export and SKU mapping but cannot change GCP invoicing timing.
2) Minimum commitment / reserved instance options: If you want committed capacity (Dedicated), procurement needs to sign monthly or annual reservations. Drafts for reservations typically add 5 business days of procurement review.

I attached a short workbook that maps SKU -> Redwood product codes and suggested billing labels for HubSpot. Please review and confirm your finance contact for PO routing.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Commercial Operations — Redwood Inference
